## Problem

Describe the user or operational problem to solve.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behavior without prescribing unnecessary implementation detail.

## Acceptance criteria

List the observable conditions that would make this complete.

## Risks and alternatives

Note security, privacy, compatibility, rollout, and maintenance considerations.
